pr_title: Grok returns a list of matches for repeated pattern names #92092
pr_body:
This commit makes the Elasticsearch Grok processor behaves the same that Logstash's grok:

when Logstash's Grok processor runs with a pattern having repeated pattern names (e.g.: `"%{IP:ip} %{IP:ip} %{anything else}"`), it returns a list of matches, instead only the first match. 

Closes #92092
pr_comments: @gmarouli You're right it's more optimal than the creation of intermediate holder objects and the code is still legible (what I was worried about mainly). I've applied the needed changes :) thanks for the feedback
